# Meridian Quarterly Intake Brief

This is a domain-neutral sample document used by the test suite as the kind of
material a user realistically pastes or uploads mid-conversation. It carries no
particular subject-matter domain — the flow suite proves mechanics on neutral
data, independent of whatever format skill is mounted.

## Background

Meridian is a fictional organization used only as a stand-in. Earlier this
quarter the intake team gathered a mix of notes, a short email thread, and a
handful of figures, and asked for them to be turned into a single structured
record. The raw material below is deliberately loose — it arrives as prose, not
as this skill's field vocabulary, so the interview has to read the whole thing
and infer what it can.

## Notes gathered

- The request originated with the intake coordinator on a Monday morning.
- Three separate items were mentioned across the thread; every item in this
  brief must be accounted for in the final record.
- Two of the items reference figures that were later revised upward.
- A follow-up meeting was scheduled but no date was fixed at the time of writing.

## Open questions

Several facts are missing from the source material and only the submitter would
know them: the exact effective moment, the responsible owner, and the final
figure for the third item. These are left unstated on purpose so the interview
must ask rather than invent.

## Closing

Everything above is illustrative filler with enough length and line count to
read as genuine pasted source material rather than a one-line answer.
